title: Auto Atlanta - 60 mm hose clamp, 993 Turbo 1995-98 (listing found through the PorscheFanatics dataset)

rights.attribution: Auto Atlanta; discovery through the PorscheFanatics parts dataset

notes: Read on 2026-11-18 through the PorscheFanatics dataset, data/parts/006.json (SHA-256 598c49b8b8e4d22f175dee0644f8ad4eceee5f931b8ed15ad7dec005a2df342b), record auto-atlanta-60mm-hose-clamp-993-turbo-95-98, which PorscheFanatics built from the listing on 2026-08-19; the listing page itself was not opened. The listing title names a 60 mm hose clamp for the 993 Turbo 1995-98, and its image file name carries 99951264702, the clamp at position 21 of PET plate 107-45. That size is consistent with the 60-80/12 clamp that SRC-PORSCHE-AUSTRIA-993-107-45-PET gives for the charge-air hoses, but neither source states which clamp sits on which end of the hose. The record gives no clamp type, band width, tightening torque, hose or spigot dimension, bead profile or standard. Used only to record what the owner's data states about the vehicle charge-air joint for input IN-02 of the 750 hp coupon 3D plan; it fills no input and is a vehicle-scale (43 to 57 mm hose) figure that a 24 mm coupon cannot carry.
